g.text: ROGUE SHOOTER · TITLE MENU · #92 · B: DEMON KING LOOMS
Concept sheet, drawn in SVG by Claude (no image model). Not shipped. Reply Pick: A, B or C on the pull request.
WORDMARK AT 3X (drawn as pixel rects, never painted: R2, R24)
"ROGUE" at 3x; in game each letter pixel is 8 px on desktop
IN CONTEXT: PLAY → CLASS SELECT (existing screen)
Idea: a lone torchlit Knight stands on the night field while the Demon King towers behind a red title and eyes glint in the dark; the menu sits off to the right.
Risk: darkest and least cozy, and it moves away from the warm farm look; it also shows the 3:00 boss up front, and red title text uses the danger color.
